description: FAOSTAT farm-gate producer prices by country for up to 20 crops in ONE call. A separate tool from producer.prices, for the same pricing reason as price.bundle. This is what a grower was paid at the farm gate — NOT an export unit value and NOT the benchmark price.latest returns; all three are correct and differ. Paid; charged only if at least one crop resolves.

codes.description: Crop instrument codes, up to 20. Example: ["CC", "KC"].

year.description: Year to summarise. Defaults to the latest stored.

name: producer.prices.bundle
title: Farm-Gate Prices for Several Crops
